children: GENESCO INC reported second-quarter FY2027 results with revenue of $529.9M, down 3% from $546M a year earlier, and net income of $3.5M versus a net loss of $18.5M in Q2 FY2026. Diluted EPS was $0.32 compared with ($1.79) in the prior-year quarter.
Revenue: $529.9M for Q2 FY2027, down from $546.0M in Q2 FY2026 ( (3.0%) YoY ).
Net income: $3.5M for Q2 FY2027, versus a net loss of $18.5M in Q2 FY2026 (improvement YoY).
Diluted EPS: $0.32 for Q2 FY2027, versus ($1.79) in Q2 FY2026.
Net sales were down 3% in the quarter and flat year‑to‑date as management continued store optimization, reducing store count by 67 year‑to‑date.
E‑commerce softened, declining 6% in Q2 as Schuh prioritized full‑price selling over promotional activity.
Brand performance was mixed: Journeys and Johnston & Murphy delivered positive comps of 2% and 4% in Q2, while Schuh comps declined 9%.
Gross margin improved, aided by tariff refunds and reduced promotion activity, supporting higher operating margin.
Operational progress included continued footprint optimization with net store closures, four remodels, and ongoing IT transformation initiatives.
